# dsm_group (Data Source)

Read-only data source for looking up an existing DSM group.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "dsm_group" "developers" {
  name = "developers"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Group name to look up.

### Read-Only

- `description` (String) Description of the group.
- `gid` (Number) Group ID assigned by DSM.
- `id` (String) Unique identifier for the group (group name).
